annotations.title: Look up one search's results now

description: Looks up Google's results for one of the website's own searches now, spending one of the month's lookups (money); refused without room or within the reuse days of the last lookup. The result arrives with the next refresh. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.
